metin.SexyKO'da **83 Level** olduktan sonra ka: In SexyKO, after reaching **Level 83** you can keep improving your character with Rebirth.
metin.Rebirth sistemi oldukça basit ve hızlıdı: The Rebirth system is very simple and quick.
metin.Karakterinize Rebirth basabilmek için:: To Rebirth your character you need:
metin.Tüm şartlar tamamlandığında karakteriniz: Once all requirements are met, you can Rebirth your character easily.
metin.Her Rebirth seviyesinde karakteriniz:: At each Rebirth level your character gets:
metin.Yani 83 Level sonrasında karakter gelişi: So your character keeps progressing after Level 83, and the higher your Rebirth level, the more extra stat points you get.
metin.Gerekli Coin, NP ve EXP şartlarını tamam: After meeting the required Coin, NP and EXP conditions, you can do your Rebirth.
metin.REBIRTH BİLGİSİ NEREDEN GÖRÜLÜR?: WHERE CAN YOU SEE REBIRTH INFO?
metin.Klavyeden **U** tuşuna basarak **Charact: Press **U** on the keyboard to open the **Character Info** window.
metin.Buradan mevcut Rebirth durumunuzu kontro: Here you can check your current Rebirth status.
metin.HER REBIRTH SEVİYESİNDE +2 STAT POINT: +2 STAT POINTS AT EVERY REBIRTH LEVEL
metin.83'ü tamamla • Rebirth yap • Statlarını: Finish 83 • Rebirth • Power up your stats
